name: session-stop-release-frees-the-held-paths
description: KTD-11 end-of-turn release, checked by its effect on both backends rather than by its answer: session A takes EXCLUSIVE on two tracked paths (preflight pre-edits, plan.md first, then CLAUDE.md) and stops, then session B pre-edits CLAUDE.md, the path A acquired last. B's acquire must be clean, the bare {ok:true} with no collision warning, because the stop released A's grants. Row 18 pins the stop's answer, which lists the paths whether or not their grants were freed; this row fails instead when the stop frees nothing, or stops before the last grant, because B would find A still holding EXCLUSIVE and get the collision envelope of row 13.
